column1: # Amendments to the frozen identity rows after the raw baseline (61b2a261), one per changed row.
# `-` is the row as the baseline projects it, `+` the row now frozen, `#` why. check_identity_rows.sh
# requires the raw baseline's projection, with exactly these replacements, to equal the frozen rows —
# so every post-baseline change is explained here, and an unexplained one still fails.
# 2026-10-17, bug 079: proof_pressure's check_nonce named `#[spec(check_nonce.spec)]`, which is no
# specification; it was "drift-checked" only because its source name keyed the removed name table. The
# attribute now names the specification its theorem evaluates, which moves its subject digest.
# 2026-10-21, bug 110 (branch backend-108-116): an array-element assignment's value is elaborated with
# the element type as its hint (Elab `.arrayIndexAssign`; Check already passed it). An integer literal
# assigned to a `u8` element is now a `u8` literal in Core instead of an `Int` literal that Lower
# coerced with a cast, so the implementation digest of every function with such an assignment moves.
# (`buf[len] = 128;`); every literal fits `u8`, so the value stored is the same, and the SSA after
# cleanup is identical to main's with register names erased (measured: reverting only the Elab hint
# restores both digests and every frozen row byte for byte). The dependency and reference rows carry
# `sha256_hash`'s digest; the reference moves with the regenerated Concrete/Proof/GeneratedAttestations.lean.
# `A` = a row ADDED after the baseline: a subject the baseline never had, so nothing migrated. It must
# be absent from the baseline projection; the frozen rows include it, sorted.
# 2026-10-19, bug 079 follow-ups (Codex land1 review): three negative subject-binding fixtures whose
# theorem mentions `add`'s specification only in a hypothesis (top-level, nested implication, irrelevant
# disjunction). Each carries a stored link so the claim exists to be refused; none binds.
# 2026-10-19, Codex land1 confirmation review: the spec inside an arbitrary function's proof argument.
# 2026-10-19, Codex land1 confirmation review: the spec nested inside the term eval runs.
# and pins each elf_header claim in source, so the aliased claim exists to be refused.
# 2026-10-20, bug 083 (land3): the name-keyed provedFunctions table's claims moved into source.
# Each function it proved by NAME now carries #[spec]/#[proof_by]/#[proof_fingerprint]: links in
# examples/ and tests/programs/; thesis_demo becomes an attested scope (its proofFns subjects and the
# two generated references selecting them). No existing row changed.
# 2026-10-20, bug 089 (land3): the three ensures-link regression fixtures each pin compute_tag's claim,
# so the bogus #[ensures_proof] sits beside a real refinement link.
# 2026-10-21, workload proofs (branch proof-workloads): examples/toml, examples/hexdump and
# examples/png_chunks gained their first proof links. Each becomes an attested scope: a link row per
# claim (7), a generated FnTable.empty reference per claim (7), the scope (3), and every extracted
# declaration as a subject (16: the 7 claimed, plus toml_parser's 8 unclaimed mk_*/is_error/err_result
# and png_chunks.is_png_sig, which are untabled). No existing row changed.
